attchmntText: Globale Tessile Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding Unaudited Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended on September 30, 2026, in  The Indian Express , English Language Newspaper and  The Financial Express , Gujarati Language Newspaper, on October 31, 2026. The copy of publication of the same are enclosed herewith.

Globale Tessile Limited has submitted to the Exchange that the Meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company held on Friday, October 30, 2026, at the Registered Office of the Company, has considered and approved Unaudited Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026 for the Financial Year 2026-27.
